texts:
Put a living 3D agent on your website in 30 seconds.

Two lines of HTML. No build step, no npm install.

Paste, refresh, and a 3D character is standing in the corner of your page, greeting visitors and answering questions.

As easy as embedding a video.

three.ws/tutorials/embed-in-30-seconds

How it works:

Build your agent at three.ws/create. Pick a character, give it a name and a personality.

Copy its ID into the two lines, and refresh your page.

It animates, greets and chats out of the box. Works in plain HTML, React and Next.js.

issues.quote: As easy as embedding a video.
issues.problem: Subjective comparison that adds length without a checkable fact; the mechanism (two tags, no build step) is already stated and stronger than the analogy.
issues.fix: Optional: cut the line, or replace with a verified mechanism such as 'One script tag loads the runtime, one <agent-3d> tag places the agent.'

issues.quote: Paste, refresh, and a 3D character is standing in the corner of your page, greeting visitors and answering questions.
issues.problem: Copywriting cadence borders on the promotional register the house style warns against, though it stays factual and supported by the tutorial text.
issues.fix: Optional: tighten to 'Save the file and refresh. The character appears in the corner, animates, and answers questions in chat.'
